sections.text: 1 Lectiones omisimus, quae in utroque cod. concinunt. Prima littera cuiusque paragraphi, quae in V deest, in N rubrica notata est.
sections.en: 1 We have omitted readings which agree in both codices. The first letter of each paragraph, which is missing in V, is marked in red in N.

summary.headline: Neapolitan–Venetian Codex Collation
summary.text: Collation specimen comparing readings in the Neapolitan and Venetian codices, listing textual variants, corrections, marginal additions, and lacunae across passages numbered 89–100. Entries include astrological terms and references to Cancer, Capricorn, Venus, the Moon, Andromeda, Arrow, Demeter, Sebennytus, and exaltation and depression.
